page.layout: One column of running text. Three marginal references in the right margin, each beside its text mark. No text in the left margin. Running head at top, page number at top right, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: est Debitum. Debitum Officii, quod quis ex præcepto juris tenetur facere : & Debitum Supplicii, quod quis ex sanctione juris tenetur pati, si officium suum neglexerit. Priori sensu dicimus mutua charitatis officia esse debita, quia lex Dei illa præcipit, juxta illud Rom.13. {r}Nihil cuiquam debete, nisi ut diligatis invicem.Rom. 13. 8. Posteriori sensu dicimus Pec-cata esse debita, ut in oratione Domi-nica, {t}Dimitte nobis debita nostra : & Mat. 6. 12.mortem æternam esse debitam, juxta illud Rom.6. {u}Stipendium peccati mors.Ro.6.23. Observandum tamen debitum posterius contrahi ex infoluto priori : ita ut si quis debitum officii plenarie diffolveret, faciendo id quod lex imperat, non tenetur aliquo debito supplicii ad patiendum id quod lex minatur. Respondet duplici huic Debito duplex item Obli-gatio, ejusdem plane denominationis : Obligatio sc. ad officium faciendum, & Obligatio ad supplicium perferendum ; vel quod communiter dicitur & eodem recidit, Obligatio ad Culpam, & Obli-gatio ad Pœnam. Ita tamen ut illa sit prior & potior, sicut natura sua, sic & intentione Juris. Tyrannidis enim est, non juris, pœnam intendere aliter quam

page.notes: Printed page is the left half of a two-page opening? No: one page, numbered 21. Left edge is cropped, so the first letters of "est", "contrahi" and "recidit" are partly lost; "est" is read from the context "eft", "contrahi" and "recidit" are reconstructed with [?] reading absent. Printed "debete" (for debere) and "Pec-cata" are kept as printed. Long s is normalised to s throughout (fenfu = sensu, fi = si, fuum = suum, fanctione = sanctione, fupplicii = supplicii, fit = sit, eft = est, fic = sic, fua = sua, ejufdem = ejusdem). Running head "Prælectio Prima." reads as printed; the ligature "ct" is uncertain. "diffolveret" is kept as printed. Text continues on the next page ("in" is the catchword).
